info.title: SecretTrace API
info.description: Secrets lifecycle tracking. Plaintext secret values never reach this API: clients send `SHA-256("secrettrace/v1\0" || normalize(value))`.

get.summary: List API tokens (never includes token values).

post.summary: Issue a token for an agent or CI. The value is returned once.

get.summary: Browse the audit log, newest first.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Exact action, or a prefix ending in `.` (e.g. `auth.`).

get.summary: Recompute the hash chain of the whole log.

post.summary: `POST /auth/login` — step 1: password. Issues a 5-minute pre-MFA session.

200.description: Password accepted; pre-MFA session cookie set

post.summary: `POST /auth/logout` — works for pre-MFA and full sessions.

get.summary:
`GET /auth/me` — current user and the CSRF token for this session (lets the SPA
recover the token after a page reload).

post.summary:
`POST /auth/mfa/enroll` — first login only: create a TOTP seed (stored encrypted,
activated by the first successful `verify`). Re-enrollment requires an admin reset.

`POST /auth/mfa/verify` — step 2: TOTP. On success the pre-MFA session is replaced
by a fresh full session (new token, new CSRF token).

`POST /auth/password` — change your own password. Other sessions are ended; this one
stays. A wrong current password counts as a failed login (lockout applies).

422.description: Wrong current password or weak new password

post.summary:
Create a canary. The value is returned once; `api_key` canaries are also registered
as secrets (named `canary: <name>`, owner `canary`).

409.description: Name taken, or canaries are not configured

get.summary: One canary with its latest hits.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a canary (a disabled one ignores hits), or edit its notes.

post.summary: Start a scan of a source (found or created by type and URI). Scope `ingest:profile`.

Finish a scan. A successful full scan marks the source's unreported locations as no
longer present. Scope `ingest:profile`.

404.description: No such scan for this token

post.summary:
Report locations of matched candidates. Digests are matched again; unregistered ones
are counted and dropped. Scope `ingest:findings`.

404.description: No such scan for this token

post.summary:
Which of the submitted digests are registered. Rate-limited per token by unique
digests; only counts are audited. Scope `ingest:match`.

404.description: No such scan for this token

get.summary: Every location of every secret, newest first sighting first.

parameters.name: in_current_state
parameters.description: `true`: still present in the last full scan; `false`: only in history.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the URI or the path.

get.summary: Dashboard: counters, the 30-day violation trend, top exposed and expiring secrets.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running server-side scan.

409.description: Finished, or reported by an API token

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, owner or purpose.

post.summary: Register a secret by its client-side digest.

409.description: Name taken or value already registered (the attempt is audited)

429.description: Too many registrations by this user

patch.summary: Update metadata, status, expiry or allow-rules. Revoked/rotated secrets cannot be reactivated.

get.summary: Where the secret has been found.

post.summary: Create a source. Credentials are referenced by name (`credential_ref`), never sent.

delete.summary: Delete a source; its active scan is cancelled, found locations are kept.

patch.summary: Update a source. `type` and `uri` are immutable; disabling cancels its active scan.

post.summary:
Queue a server-side scan of a git repository source. Optional body `{"full": true}`
rescans the whole history instead of only what is new since the last scan.

409.description: Source disabled, or a scan is already queued or running

415.description: Non-empty body that is not JSON

422.description: Not a git_repo source, or invalid body

post.summary: Create a user with an initial password; TOTP enrollment happens at their first login.

patch.summary: Change a user's role or enable/disable the account.

409.description: Own account, or the last active admin

post.summary: Set a new password for another user, unlock the account and end its sessions.
Remove the user's TOTP enrollment and end their sessions; they enroll again at next login.
Clear the failed-login counter and lock.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up and serving.

ActiveScan.description: The queued or running server-side scan of a source.

AllowRuleIn.description: Where a secret is allowed to appear. All set fields must match.

path_pattern.description: Glob over the path inside the source.

oneOf.description: Restrict to one source type; omit for any.

uri_pattern.description: Glob over the source URI (repo URL, `host:<name>`, …). `*` stops at `/`, `**` does not.

actor_name.description: Username or token name of the actor, when it still exists.

planted_at.description: Where it will be planted (free text, for whoever reads the alert).

hits.description: The latest 100 stored hits, newest first.

secret_id.description: The registered secret of an `api_key` canary: scans that find it report a leak.

cert_cn.description:
CN of the client certificate the token must arrive with (through the mTLS
endpoint), 1-64 of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`. Required when the server enforces client
certificates.

environment.description: Scans are recorded under this environment; the token cannot claim another.

expires_in_days.description: Days until expiry (1..=365). Tokens always expire.

oneOf.description: Only sources of this type may be reported.

source_uri_pattern.description: Only source URIs matching this glob may be reported (`*` stops at `/`, `**` does not).

CreatedCanary.description: Returned once: only an HMAC of the token is stored.

endpoint.description: The fake service endpoint of an `api_key` canary.

snippet.description: Ready to plant: the link, or `.env` lines with endpoint and key.

value.description: The link (`url`) or the fake key (`api_key`).

token.description: Shown exactly once; only its hash is stored.

FindingIn.description: One location of a candidate. Only metadata: never the value or file contents.

blob.description: Git blob id (40 or 64 lowercase hex).

commit.description: Git commit id (40 or 64 lowercase hex).

key.description: Name of the key the value was assigned to, 1-64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]`.

locator.description: `{path, line, column, commit, blob, ref, encoding}` — never file contents.

ignored.description: Findings whose digest is not registered (nothing stored).

violations.description: Accepted locations not covered by an allow rule.

path.description: Request target with the token replaced by `{token}`.

exposed_secrets.description: Secrets with at least one violation.

historical_violations.description: Not allowed, seen only in history (still a leak: history is readable).

open_violations.description: Not allowed and still present in the current state of the source.

locator.description: `{path, line, column, commit, blob, ref, encoding}` — never file contents.

digests.description: Client-side digests (64 lowercase hex); duplicates are ignored.

matched.description: The submitted digests that are registered, sorted. Names and ids are never returned.

expiring.description: Active secrets expiring soonest within 30 days (up to 5).

scans_24h.description: Scans created in the last 24 hours, by status.

top_exposed.description: Secrets with the most violations (up to 5).

violations_by_day.description: New violations per day (UTC, by first sighting), oldest first, last 30 days.

actor_name.description: Username or token name of the actor, when it still exists.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

locator.description: `{path, line, column, commit, blob, ref, encoding}` — never file contents.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

locator.description: `{path, line, column, commit, blob, ref, encoding}` — never file contents.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

error.description: Failure or cancellation reason; never file contents.

full_scan.description: Whole history (`true`) or only what is new since the last scan.

run_after.description: Not claimed before this time (retry backoff).

source_name.description: Name of the source (absent once the source is deleted).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

is_expired.description: `true` when `expires_at` has passed (even before the expiry job flips `status`).

masked.description: Built from stored hints only, e.g. `AKIA…` or `••••••••`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

oneOf.description: The queued or running server-side (manual/scheduled) scan, if any.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

Role.description: Role of a human user. Declaration order defines privilege: `Viewer < Operator < Admin`.

error.description: Short failure reason (≤ 500 chars). Never file contents.

stats.description: Counters only: up to 32 keys of `[a-z0-9_]`, non-negative integers.

no_longer_present.description: Locations of the source marked as no longer in its current state (full scans).

error.description: Failure or cancellation reason; never file contents.

full_scan.description: Whole history (`true`) or only what is new since the last scan.

run_after.description: Not claimed before this time (retry backoff).

source_name.description: Name of the source (absent once the source is deleted).

full.description: Scan the whole history, ignoring what earlier scans covered.

environment.description: 1-64 chars of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`; matched exactly by allow rules.

full.description:
The scan covers the whole current state of the source: on success, locations it did
not report are marked as no longer present.

ScanTrigger.description: What started a scan: a user (`manual`), the scheduler, or an API token (`ci`, `agent`).

expiring_soon.description: Active secrets whose `expires_at` is within the next 30 days.

SecretCreate.description:
Registration request. `digest` is computed client-side (`secrettrace digest`
or the web UI); the plaintext value is never sent.

is_expired.description: `true` when `expires_at` has passed (even before the expiry job flips `status`).

masked.description: Built from stored hints only, e.g. `AKIA…` or `••••••••`.

SecretRef.description: The secret a finding belongs to, as the UI shows it.

SecretType.description: Kind of a registered secret. Mirrors the `secret_type` Postgres ENUM.

SecretUpdate.description:
Partial update. Absent fields are unchanged; `null` clears nullable fields.
`allow_rules`, when present, replaces the whole set.

SourceConfig.description: Per-source scan settings. Never holds credentials.

max_blob_bytes.description: Skip blobs larger than this (default: the worker's limit, 16 MiB).

username.description:
User name for HTTPS (with the token from `credential_ref`) or for `ssh://` URIs
without one. Default for HTTPS: `x-access-token`.

credential_ref.description: Name of a credential file in the worker's credentials directory (never a value).

schedule.description: 5-field cron expression in UTC, at most every 5 minutes; `git_repo` only.

oneOf.description: The queued or running server-side (manual/scheduled) scan, if any.

uri.description: Repository URL, host path, image reference… Must not contain credentials.

SourceUpdate.description:
Partial update. Absent fields are unchanged; `null` clears nullable fields;
`config`, when present, replaces the whole object. `type` and `uri` cannot change.

password.description: Initial password (at least 12 characters). TOTP is enrolled at first login.

is_locked.description: Temporarily locked after repeated failed logins.

mfa_enabled.description: TOTP enrolled. Until then the user enrolls at the next login.

is_active.description: `false` disables the account and ends its sessions.

head.description: Hash of the newest row (hex); keep a copy out of band to detect tail truncation.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Required on POST/PATCH/DELETE with a session; returned by login, verify and /auth/me

token.description: API token for agents and CI
